observed_bottleneck: With only 290 adaptive oracle calls after the ten fixed initial molecules, a task-agnostic de novo constructor must convert sparse rank feedback into reusable structural bias while continuing to generate complete valid molecules, without retrieving corpus molecules or depending on a learned value function or surrogate.
hypothesis: Infer a valence-preserving, context-conditioned molecular hypergraph-replacement grammar and categorical production prior from the unlabeled corpus, then optimize each independent objective by repeatedly hard-selecting elite complete evaluated derivations and applying a smoothed maximum-likelihood cross-entropy projection of the production distribution toward those elites before ancestrally sampling new complete derivations.
method_thesis: Infer a valence-preserving molecular hypergraph-replacement grammar and context-conditioned production-rule prior from the allowed unlabeled corpus, retaining only reusable rules and counts rather than whole corpus molecules. In each independently restarted objective session, parse the ten fixed scored molecules into grammar derivations and initialize a task-local categorical rule distribution from the corpus prior. Generate every subsequent proposal de novo by ancestrally sampling a complete derivation from the start symbol, applying its productions to obtain a molecular graph, and locally resampling after invalid, previously evaluated, or duplicate outcomes until the evaluator-announced batch is full. After each oracle response, select the highest-ranked evaluated derivations and perform the defining cross-entropy update: maximum-likelihood refit the context-conditioned rule probabilities to that elite set, with fixed smoothing toward the preceding distribution. Thus feedback moves probability mass toward production combinations occurring in the best complete molecules without crossover, mutation, a surrogate, a value function, or a finite candidate library; the sole optimization target is a stronger terminal Top-1 in each of the five independent sessions and hence their equal-weight mean.
